top_signals.title: Stocks stumble on inflation fears, but 2 of our names give us reasons to stay bullish
top_signals.summary: Stocks came under pressure last week as surging oil prices and bond yields stoked renewed concerns about inflation and the Fed's next move.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Luxury Shoppers Put Value Ahead of Labels
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Pursuits Global Luxury Editor editor Chris Rovzar says luxury shoppers are increasingly prioritizing price, quality and lasting value over labels, helping brands such as Coach and Ralph Lauren gain ground as parts of the broader luxury industry struggle. Joining David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend, Rovzar explains that New York Fashion Week is also showing renewed momentum for American fashion, with heritage brands and designers embracing color, archival influences and more accessible luxury. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: RBI Said to Reject Tata Sons Request to Avoid An IPO
top_signals.summary: India’s central bank rejected an application from Tata Sons Pvt. to surrender its status as a shadow lender, according to people familiar with the matter, signaling it expects the company to adhere with rules for such entities that include an initial public offering.
